data.name: Darkspy
data.detailed_description:
Experience the ultimate blend of tactical espionage and high-stakes stealth gameplay in this spy thriller set in a dystopian version of our own world where shadow organizations vie for power.

In 2040, rogue AI technology threatens global stability. As Viper-1, an elite government operative, you’ll infiltrate fortified compounds, sabotage critical infrastructure, and manipulate the balance of power in a world where every choice has lasting consequences. Your actions will decide who lives, who dies, and who controls the future.

Will you dismantle Horizon’s conspiracy—or become part of it?

Features

  • Immersive Sim-Level Design
    Explore vast, highly-detailed maps with verticality, multiple infiltration routes, and interconnected shortcuts. Every location rewards creative problem-solving and experimentation.

  • Cutting-Edge Spy Arsenal
    Equip cybernetic augments, suppressed firearms, advanced hacking tools, deployable drones, and experimental espionage gadgets to outsmart and outmaneuver the enemy.

  • Three Distinct Playstyles
    Ghost through missions unseen, strike from the shadows with surgical precision, or unleash all-out combat. Adapt your tactics to the situation and your own moral code.

  • Rogue-Lite Mission Loop
    Face randomized objectives across global campaigns with permadeath between runs. Every mission is a new test of skill, planning, and adaptability.

  • Reactive Resistance
    Your enemies learn from you. Over time, they upgrade their tech, deploy new tactics, and adapt to your previous strategies, forcing you to constantly evolve.

  • Augments, Gadgets & Skills
    Unlock and upgrade specialized abilities to enhance infiltration, combat, or deception—crafting a build that fits your unique approach.

  • Mission Trilemma
    Choose your insertion point, time of day, and mission order carefully—your decisions will shape survival chances, alliances, and moral dilemmas.

  • Unravel the Horizon Conspiracy
    Discover hidden intel, unlock side objectives, and decide who you can truly trust. Every piece of information changes how you see the story.

  • A Living, Breathing World
    Civilian NPCs, dynamic weather, and atmospheric lighting make each infiltration feel tense, unpredictable, and alive.

  • Modes & Mastery
    Take on Endless Mode, Ghost Runs, Time Trials, and challenge modifiers—or aim for 100% completion by unlocking every upgrade and perfecting every mission.

data.short_description: Darkspy is a hardcore first-person stealth shooter with tactical mission planning, reactive AI, and rogue-lite structure. Infiltrate enemy strongholds, choose your loadout and insertion point, and shape the world through your decisions.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 (6 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 580 (8 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 50 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
